title: The Trinity

canonical_node.axiom: God is one being in three persons: Father, Son, and Holy Spirit, who are distinct yet fully united in being, love, and will.
definitions: Trinity: one God in three persons, not three gods, not one person in three modes.
Existence: God as being itself (ipsum esse subsistens).
Distinction: real difference among the persons, original in God.
Relation: the mutual indwelling (perichoresis) and begetting/proceeding among persons.
Orientation: the mutual self-gift and love among persons, the gradient of good.
Aseity: God's self-existence; God does not have existence but is existence.
Perichoresis: mutual indwelling of the persons.
Tota simul: the whole, simultaneous, perfect possession of unending life (Boethius).
derivation: The document asserts the Trinity as the ground of all reality, prior to creation.
It identifies four fundamental assumptions (existence, distinction, relation, orientation) that all worldviews presuppose.
It claims these four debts are dissolved in the Trinity: existence as aseity, distinction as persons, relation as perichoresis, orientation as love.
It presents a mathematical isomorphism between quaternion electromagnetism and the Trinity structure, claimed to be Lean 4 verified.
It derives seven terms (T.1-T.7) from this isomorphism, each mapping a physical concept to a divine attribute.
It defines truth as a three-mode structure (Being, Expression, Witness) corresponding to the persons.
It outlines an order of operations from eternity to consummation, as logical moments in God's single act.
canonical_node.action: The system should treat the Trinity as the foundational axiom, using the four-fold structure (existence, distinction, relation, orientation) to interpret all other claims, and maintain the distinction between theological interpretation and formal derivation.
boundary: Does not claim to formally derive the Trinity from logic or physics.
Does not claim that the Lean 4 verification proves the theological identification, only the mathematical structure.
Does not claim that the four debts are only payable by the Trinity; rival ontologies may ground them differently.
Does not claim to have a physics of temporal origination; time-authored is a theological claim.
Does not include the Watcher, Anti-Properties, Hard Questions, or Three Postulates in this document.
test: Check that all statements about the Trinity are consistent with the definitions of existence, distinction, relation, orientation.
Verify that any claim of formal derivation is labeled as such and not conflated with theological interpretation.
Ensure that the Lean 4 verification is cited only for the mathematical isomorphism, not for the theological identification.
Check that the four debts are presented as assumptions, not as proven necessities.
Verify that the boundary conditions are respected: no overclaiming of physics from theology.

dg1_dependencies: Church Fathers (Gregory of Nazianzus, John of Damascus, Augustine)
Philosophical sources (Leibniz, Aristotle, Hume, Boethius, Aquinas)
dg_protocol.dg2_new_capability: Provides a unified framework that grounds existence, distinction, relation, and orientation in the Trinity, offering a theological interpretation of these fundamental assumptions.
dg_protocol.dg3_preserved_floor: Preserves the truth of the four debts as real assumptions; does not deny their validity.
dg_protocol.dg4_collapse_if_removed: If the Trinity axiom is removed, the framework loses its grounding for the four debts, reducing to a set of ungrounded assumptions.
dg5_translation_registers: Philosophical register: existence, distinction, relation, orientation
Physical register: quaternion EM, coupling constants, Noether's theorem

overstatement_risks: Claiming the Lean 4 verification proves the theological identification.
Presenting the four debts as necessarily grounded in the Trinity.
Treating the physical analogies (e.g., coupling constants) as literal identities.
Overstating the formal status of the derivative terms T.1-T.7.
kill_conditions: If the Lean 4 verification is found to be flawed or not reproducible.
If the theological interpretation is presented as a formal derivation.
If the document claims to have derived physics from theology without qualification.
risk.lean_target: The quaternion EM / Trinity isomorphism, claimed to be Lean 4 verified with zero sorry.

plain_summary: This document presents the Trinity as the foundational axiom, interpreting existence, distinction, relation, and orientation as aspects of God. It claims a Lean 4 verified mathematical isomorphism between quaternion electromagnetism and the Trinity structure, but explicitly notes that this verifies only the math, not the theology. The document is a theological framework with some formal mathematical support, but many claims are analogical or interpretive, not proven.
